patient.type: synthetic engine reference; not an experimental subject
patient.construction: SEPatientConfiguration.GetPatient API; Name and Sex explicitly set; native defaults for other fields
patient.numeric_baseline_parameters: NOT_ASSIGNED_BY_POLY; read all resolved defaults and units after initialization
patient.license_basis: Original POLY configuration proposal referencing Apache-2.0 engine API; no third-party patient-state file copied
patient.scope: HumanAdultWholeBody adult reference; no pediatric/disease generalization

build.native_interface: C++20 enforced by pinned CMakeLists.txt; README C++17 is stale
build.minimum_cmake: 3.31 per pinned CMakeLists.txt; README says 3.12 and is stale for this snapshot
build.mode: Release native built with portable LLVM-MinGW; C++20
build.data_rule: Turning either Java or Python API off disables default data generation; native-only build still needs qualified generated data from matching source
build.externaldata_baselines: data/CMakeLists downloads validation archives by SHA512 when requested; not required to copy all archives in phase 1
build.isolation_rule: Use dedicated build and language environments; never mutate bundled Codex runtime
build.dependency_status: Selected native dependencies built locally; exact artifacts and retained license/NOTICE hashes in PHASE2_BUILD_RECEIPT.json

environment_observation.method: Get-Command on PATH plus vswhere C++ component query when available
environment_observation.limits: Absence on PATH does not establish absence from all disks; no software installed

before_future_execution: Pin generated runtime data and binary hashes
Record dependency licenses/notices and isolated build environment
Initialize patient successfully with bounds enabled and no conditions
Capture resolved initial patient, native engine version/hash, actual dt and time
Write state bytes and SHA-256; select baseline/effect/convergence thresholds before experiment
